usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the full list of built-in Proxmox firewall macro names and their descriptions before writing firewall rules that reference a macro in the 'macro' field. No authentication privilege is required beyond a valid login — any API token or user can call this. The list is static and cluster-wide; it reflects macros baked into the Proxmox firewall engine, not custom rules.

examples.summary: List all available firewall macros to find the correct name before creating a rule

tips: Macro names are case-sensitive when used in firewall rules (e.g., 'SSH' not 'ssh').
This endpoint returns no pagination — the full macro list is always returned in a single response.
Use the 'descr' field to understand what traffic a macro covers before applying it to a rule.
